# Spinner

Pending work in place: a turning mark with a status text.

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: HTML `a mark with role="status" text`

## Anatomy

- **mark**: Turning ring; dotted and still under reduced motion.
- **text**: Visible or visually hidden status.

## Variants

- `inline`: Inside a button (aria-busy).
- `block`: In place of content.

## States

- `default`

## Accessibility

- Role: status

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide (A)
- 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA)
- 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA)
